test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following operating systems is most suitable for ethical hacking and cybersecurity tasks on laptops and desktops due to its pre-installed penetration testing tools?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kali Linux**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kali Linux** is a specialized operating system widely used in **ethical hacking, penetration testing, and cybersecurity tasks.**
 
• It is based on **Debian Linux** and comes with a wide array of **pre-installed tools** designed for digital forensics and information security.
 
• Kali Linux is maintained and developed by **Offensive Security**, a leading organization in cybersecurity training and solutions.
 
• Some of the popular tools included in Kali Linux are **Nmap, Wireshark, Metasploit, John the Ripper, and Aircrack-ng.**
 
• It supports a variety of platforms, including **laptops, desktops, Raspberry Pi, and mobile devices.**
 
• Kali Linux allows ethical hackers and security professionals to efficiently perform **vulnerability assessments, security audits, and penetration testing.**
 
• The operating system is open-source and provides strong community support, making it an excellent choice for **cybersecurity enthusiasts and professionals.**
 
• Kali Linux also includes advanced features such as **customizable penetration testing environments, live boot options, and multi-language support.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ubuntu LTS**__

 __
 
• **Ubuntu** is a popular Linux distribution based on **Debian**, known for its **user-friendly interface** and robust performance.
 
• It is primarily used for **general computing tasks, software development, and server management.**
 
• **Ubuntu LTS (Long Term Support)** versions receive regular updates and security patches for up to five years, making it ideal for stable and reliable systems.
 
• While it is versatile, it lacks the specialized tools pre-installed in **Kali Linux** that are essential for penetration testing and ethical hacking.
 
 
 
• **macOS Ventura**__
 __
 
• **macOS Ventura** is the latest version of Apple's operating system for **Mac computers.**
 
• It is known for its **seamless integration** with Apple’s ecosystem, smooth user experience, and advanced features like **Stage Manager and Continuity Camera.**
 
• macOS is primarily designed for **general computing tasks, creative work, and software development.**
 
• While macOS supports some cybersecurity tools, it is not specifically tailored for **penetration testing or ethical hacking.**
 
 
 
• **Windows 10**__
 
 
• **Windows 10** is one of the most widely used operating systems globally, developed by **Microsoft.**
 
• It is primarily designed for **general computing tasks, gaming, and office productivity.**
 
• Windows supports third-party cybersecurity tools but lacks the **pre-installed penetration testing features** found in Kali Linux.
 
• It is not an ideal choice for ethical hacking due to its **closed-source nature** and limited customization options for security professionals.
